title: festuca olgae subsp. deasyi
intro: Festuca olgae subsp. deasyi, commonly known as Deasy's fescue, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine, particularly in the traditional practices of the indigenous communities in the Andean region, where it is valued for its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Deasy's fescue are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, which can help in treating various health conditions such as skin infections and wounds. The bioactive constituents of Festuca olgae subsp. deasyi include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
